newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fiat Brazil unit to build new truck plant.
newsitem.headline: Fiat Brazil unit to build new truck plant.

text.p: Fiat SpA's Brazilian unit said it will invest between $150 million and $200 million to build a truck plant in Minas Gerais state to produce pick-up vans and light trucks.
"The new plant will be located in Belo Horizonte city and is expected to produce 100,000 vehicles a year," said a spokesman for the local unit, who asked not to be named.
The new plant, which is expected to start operations within two years, will create 1,000 direct jobs, the spokesman added.
Pick-up vans and light trucks will be launched next year using the Palio model platform as a base, he said.
